blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The state-run Development Bank of the Philippines (DBP) has agreed to provide the Manila local government with a digital payment program to disburse financial assistance and social benefits starting next year. In a statement, DBP said it aims to roll out the program in January 2027 and expects it to benefit more than 320,000 Manila residents by reducing operational and cash-handling risks.
